 +Practice
 Travel medicine 
 Dengue infection linked to increase in Guillain–Barré syndrome risk
 By Joan Ingram 
 Friday 20 November 2026, 08:00 AM 
 Dengue infection can be acquired via a single bite from an Aedes mosquito [Image: Muhammad Mahdi Karim, GFDL 1.2, via Wikimedia Commons] 
 Infectious diseases physician Joan Ingram reviews a large Brazilian study that found a significant increase in the risk of Guillain–Barré syndrome soon after onset of dengue symptoms
 Key points , A large Brazilian study found an increased risk of Guillain–Barré syndrome after laboratory-confirmed dengue – the risk was greatest in the first two , Pract Green w Pale Yellow
